headline: Record sales · industry-leading margin holds
summary_short: Linde reported Q2 2026 sales of $9.29B (+9% y/y) with underlying growth of 4% on 2% price + 2% volume, driven by electronics, manufacturing, and chemicals/energy. Adjusted EPS $4.50 (+10%) at industry-leading 29.5% operating margin.
summary_long: Sales of $9.29B included 2% favorable currency; underlying growth was 4% (2% price + 2% volume). Electronics end market led on continued semi capex momentum plus a new long-term US supply contract that pushed the sale-of-gas backlog to a record $8.1B. Adjusted operating profit of $2.74B (+7%) with margin at 29.5%, down 60 bps y/y as cost inflation offset productivity/price. GAAP EPS $4.15 (+11%); adjusted $4.50 (+10%). Cash from operations $2.27B (+3%); free cash flow of $833M after $1.44B capex. Returned $1.59B to shareholders. Q3 adjusted EPS guidance $4.45-$4.55 (+6-8% y/y); FY2026 guidance $17.70-$17.90 (+8-9% y/y assuming +1% FX). FY capex $5.5-$6.0B to support growth + the record backlog.

drivers.explanation: Underlying volume +2% led by electronics, manufacturing, and chemicals & energy end markets; +2% price attainment; +2% favorable FX; +1% acquisitions.
Higher price attainment and productivity initiatives more than offset by cost inflation. -60 bps y/y.
Operating profit growth + share buybacks and stable tax rate. +10% y/y with adjusted net income up 8%.
CEO cited record sales and EPS with industry-leading 29.5% operating margin and 23.5% return on capital, plus a new US electronics supply contract lifting the sale-of-gas backlog to a record $8.1B.
